title: Index cards with records of the ET interviews

tellings.quote: the the military guys that were there showed him these these cards.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, passes on what he says a man named Oscar Wolf told him: at S4, a site said to be linked to Area 51, a secret US military base in Nevada, military men showed Wolf a set of index cards recording interviews with extraterrestrials. If true, it would mean the government has written records of talking with beings from elsewhere.
